scope: Exact Java operation fragments with fresh literal fixture; supplemental checks after each fragment and inside tracker sweep. Component/mass relative tolerance1e-6, energy1e-5; API percentages independently reconstructed. Local helper adds pump work. Synthetic charts and ratings are screening data; no vendor/field/cavitation/erosion/AIV calibration.
science_corrections: Percent-summary dimensional error corrected in display and80/95/85/75 thresholds; fraction APIs remain unchanged.

Native maps checked: separator six keys and minute retention; compressor six core keys withpercent power and optionaltemperature; pump NPSH metric dimensional/monotonic caveat; no fabricated head/level keys.
Compressor generated chart activation is followed by rerun in fixture and standalone cases.
Pipeline now explicitly initializes mechanical design before autoSize so ratings are actually assigned.
Tracker uses integer steps to include both50% and130% endpoints.
Additive API preset clears existing selection in narrow example.
Economics checks CAPEX atfirstYear1 and distinguishes annual-value storage from true marginal shadow price.
Configuration types and severity metadata do not imply universal protective or optimizer behavior.
